settingsUi.title: Settings
settingsUi.accountDescription: See and change your endue.ai account settings. What you change applies on endue.ai too.
settingsUi.appearanceDescription: Choose how Desk looks on this device.
settingsUi.keyboardDescription: View and customize shortcuts for the commands you use.
settingsUi.notificationsDescription: Choose when notifications can interrupt your work.
settingsUi.marketDescription: Install views, packs, plugins, themes and design systems. What each would be allowed is shown first.
settingsUi.connectionsDescription: Connect the services Desk brings data in from. Tokens stay on this computer.
settingsUi.pluginsDescription: Settings of the plugins that are on. A change applies at once and is kept next time.
settingsUi.pluginsEmpty: No plugin that is on has settings.
settingsUi.pluginsOnOffHint: The Plugins window lists every installed plugin and turns each on or off.
settingsUi.initHint: The settings you write by hand. Values changed here apply over it.
settingsUi.accessibilityDescription: Adjust the display for a more comfortable experience.
settingsUi.local: Changes are saved automatically and kept the next time you open Desk.
settingsUi.shortcutHint: Record a key combination to assign it to a command.
settingsUi.wallpaperHint: Wallpaper moves with normal windows. The pond ripples when windows open; the aurora drifts slowly.
settingsUi.contrastHint: Make text and boundaries easier to distinguish.
settingsUi.dndHint: Pause regular notifications. Error notifications can still appear.
settingsUi.historyHint: Paused notifications remain in your notification history.
settingsUi.restoreConfirm: Remove all personal shortcuts and restore the defaults?
settingsUi.record: Press a shortcut · Esc to cancel
settingsUi.invalid: Use Command, Control or Alt with a key, or a function key.
settingsUi.conflict: This shortcut is already assigned to:
settingsUi.paletteKeyHint: Opens Search Desk while you use any app. A change applies at once.
settingsUi.paletteKeyEris: {key} already summons Eris from any app. Choose another key.
settingsUi.paletteKeyDesk: {key} also runs “{command}” in the desk; from now on it opens Search Desk instead, from any app.
settingsUi.paletteKeyEnv: The environment variable DESK_PALETTE_SHORTCUT sets this key. A key chosen here is saved and used without it.
settingsUi.paletteKeyRefused: {key} can't be used: {why}. The key held before stays.
settingsUi.account.title: endue account
settingsUi.account.signedOutHint: Sign in to see and change your endue.ai profile, language and time zone, and notifications here.
settingsUi.account.confirmCode: Confirm this code on the endue ID page in your browser.
settingsUi.account.name: Name
settingsUi.account.avatarHint: Leave it empty to remove the picture.
settingsUi.account.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 200 characters.
settingsUi.account.urlInvalid: Please enter a valid URL (http:// or https://).
settingsUi.account.displayLanguageHint: The language endue.ai uses. Desk itself follows this computer's language.
settingsUi.account.timeZoneHint: Used for scheduling and date display
settingsUi.account.notificationsHint: What reaches your endue.ai inbox. Turn on push notifications on endue.ai, on each device.
settingsUi.account.partFailed: endue did not answer for these settings.
settingsUi.account.offline: Desk could not reach endue. Check your connection and try again.
settingsUi.account.footnote: Changes are saved to your endue account at once and apply on endue.ai too.
settingsUi.account.kindHint.conversation: When an agent finishes a response while you are away
settingsUi.account.kindHint.routineSkipp: When a scheduled run is skipped because a usage limit was reached
settingsUi.account.kindHint.agentNotice: When an agent decides you need to know something during a scheduled run
settingsUi.languageHint: The language the desk speaks. Follow the system uses your computer’s language when the desk speaks it.
settingsUi.connections.name: Name
settingsUi.connections.secret: Kept on this computer only and never shown again.
settingsUi.connections.reauth: Connect again with a new token.
settingsUi.conflicts.heading: Shortcut conflicts
settingsUi.conflicts.intro: These shortcuts do not run as they are set.
settingsUi.conflicts.offThere: Turn that shortcut off in the system's settings, or give this command another key.
settingsUi.conflicts.does.opensThePalett: opens the palette from any app
settingsUi.conflicts.duplicate: {other} has this key too and runs instead ({who}).
settingsUi.conflicts.prefixFirst: {keys} runs {other} first, so this key can never be finished.
settingsUi.conflicts.startsWith: {keys} starts with this key, so pressing it only waits for the next key.
settingsUi.market.removeAsk: Remove it? You can install it again here.
settingsUi.market.code: Code installs from the endue market only.
